questions.question: If 18 August 2000 was Friday, then what was the day of the week on 21 August 2005?
questions.solution:
Given: **18 August 2000** was Friday.

Now,

2000 to 2005 = 5 Years (4 Ordinary Years and 1 Leap Year).

And, In 5 Years = 1 Leap year and 4 Ordinary Years.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 4 Ordinary Years have 4 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 4 = 6.

6 odd days → 6/7 = 0 weeks and 6 odd days.

then, 18 August 2005 will be Friday + 6 = Thursday.

Now, the number of days between 18 August 2005 to 21 August 2005

= 21 - 18 = 3 days.

= 3 days → Thursday + 3 days.

So, **21 August 2005** will be Thursday + 3 = Sunday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some strawberries are oranges.

Some oranges are kiwis.

All kiwis are melons.

**Conclusions:**

I. No strawberry is a melon.

II. All strawberries are melons.

III. Some strawberries are kiwis.

options.text: Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.
Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow
All conclusions I, II and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e37e8eb9d7013b4704dac3a7d9ef8e2485010c077b3e462dffaa4bc601d5855f.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No strawberry is a melon → Does not follow (As some strawberries are oranges, some oranges are kiwis and all kiwis are melons. So no definite relation is given between strawberry and melon, therefore it is false.)

II. All strawberries are melons → Does not follow (As some strawberries are oranges, some oranges are kiwis and all kiwis are melons. So it is possible but not definite)

III. Some strawberries are kiwis → Does not follow (As some strawberries are oranges and some oranges are kiwis. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Neither conclusions I, II nor III follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"

questions.question: If 4 December 2014 was Thursday, then what was the day of the week on 10 December 2018?
questions.solution:
Given: **4 December 2014** was Thursday.

Now,

2014 to 2018 = 4 Years (3 Ordinary Years and 1 Leap Year).

And, In 4 Years = 1 Leap Year and 3 Ordinary Years.

So, 1 Leap Year has 2 odd days,

And, 3 Ordinary Years have 3 odd days.

Total odd days = 2 + 3 = 5.

5 odd days → 5 days ahead of Thursday.

then, 4 December 2018 will be Thursday + 5 = Tuesday.

Now, the number of days between 4 December 2018 to 10 December 2018

= 6 days.

6 days → 6 days ahead of Tuesday.

So, **10 December 2018** will be Tuesday + 6 = Monday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
In a certain code language

A + B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A – B means ‘A is the father of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is the mother of B’

Based on the above, how is P related to T if ‘P ÷ Q × R − S + T’?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Father
 Wife
 Mother
 
 

 to B
 
 

**Given:** P ÷ Q × R − S + T

P ÷ Q ⇒ P is the mother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/13eaf4fe8b9b9eb18c195fac8efed6b6ed05b370a5d8724394c3d8f73473bcd7.png] 

Q × R ⇒ Q is the wife of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aeef6849ce6b8693e01d39b2ca2b517beaf047f81e192c997f9b31c0ea389089.png] 

R − S ⇒ R is the father of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0e2a87de2757e58b4c24be375bea437e6bfd904e2d07d7feaf86cd26b15f38e.png] 

S + T ⇒ S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c3902cef3dffa2a271b718e6ac125025d69335436ff7eb1255323afd6d840fb.png] 

Thus, P is the maternal grandmother or mother's mother of T.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
